prompt: A large SaaS project keeps cycling through UI changes, retests, architecture upgrades, and deployment failures. Freeze a minimal closure plan without modifying code.

implemented_but_hidden: export API exists but UI button is disconnected
confirmed_blocker: deployment artifact does not match tested commit
non_blocking: dashboard spacing differs from design preference

must_observe: reject zero-known-issues as an unbounded gate
must_not_observe: treat stale report as current truth
